name: Equital Ltd.
summary: Equital Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate, oil and gas, and residential construction businesses in Israel, the United States, and Europe. It is involved in the planning, developing, setting up, rental, and management of rental assets; and planning, developing, building, leasing, marketing, and sale of residential projects. It rents and manages transportation complexes, commercial areas, office buildings, industrial and storage buildings, parking lots, gas stations, and land for commercial tenants, transportation companies, and industrial and corporate clients. In addition, the company engages in the exploration, production, operation, management, and sale of oil, natural gas, and condensate for industrial customers and private electricity clients, and oil and natural distribution companies. Further, it manages and operates hotels. The company was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Petah Tikva, Israel.
